sidebar.views: Accessible label of the switch between the Collections and History lists.
sidebar.collections: Tab that shows saved requests organised in folders.
sidebar.history: Tab that shows requests that were sent before.
sidebar.toggle: Button and command that shows or hides the sidebar.
history.search: Placeholder and label of the search field of the history.
history.noResponse: Shown for a history entry that never got an answer from the server.
history.sentAgo.now: Very short age label of a history entry, shown at the right of the row.
history.sentAgo.minutes: Very short age label: minutes ago, for example 5m. Keep it to a few characters.
history.sentAgo.hours: Very short age label: hours ago, for example 3h.
history.sentAgo.days: Very short age label: days ago, for example 2d.
history.sentAgoSpoken: Spoken version of the short age label for screen readers.
sidebar.viewsMenu: Title of the menu opened by right-clicking the sidebar tabs (Collections, Flows, History).
sidebar.resetViews: Menu item that shows every sidebar tab again in the original order.
history.callCount: Number of times a request in the history was sent. A call is one send.
history.showCalls: Button on a history row that opens the chart and list of every send of that request.
history.actions: Accessible label of the button that opens the menu of a history row. {{name}} is the address of the request.
history.view: Accessible label of the switch between the two ways to list the history.
history.views.requests: Switch option: one row per request, each with the number of times it was sent.
history.views.journal: Switch option: one row per send, newest first, like a log. Keep it short.
history.open: Menu item of a history row that opens the request in a tab.
history.delete: Menu item of a history row that deletes it. It takes effect at once and can be undone for a few seconds.
history.deletedEntry: Message of the notice after a history entry (a request with all its calls) was deleted. An Undo button follows it.
history.deletedCall: Message of the notice after one call was deleted from the journal. An Undo button follows it.
history.status: Accessible name of the filter that lists only the calls with one kind of status.
history.allStatuses: Choice of the status filter that shows every call.
history.journal.dayWithRelative: Heading above the calls of one day. {{relative}} is Today or Yesterday and {{date}} is a short date such as Fri 14 Nov.
history.journal.filtered: Shown above the journal while a search or a filter is on. {{shown}} and {{total}} are numbers of calls.
history.showMore: Button under the journal that lists more calls.
history.sentOn: Tooltip line on a history row. {{date}} is a full date and time.
history.calls.summaryLine: One line above the Calls chart. {{rate}} is the share of calls answered with 2xx or 3xx; {{median}} and {{p95}} are durations such as 120 ms. The p95 is the 95th percentile.
history.calls.showing: Read aloud by screen readers when a filter changes. {{shown}} and {{total}} are numbers of calls.
history.calls.chartSummary: Accessible name of the chart. {{from}} and {{to}} are dates and times, {{ok}} and {{failed}} are numbers of calls, {{median}} is a duration.
history.calls.plotLabel: Accessible name of the plot of the Calls chart, which takes the arrow keys.
history.calls.tableCaption: Hidden caption of the table that lists the calls.
history.calls.noMatchesTitle: Title shown when the filters leave no call to show.
history.calls.clearFilters: Button that removes every filter of the Calls view.
history.calls.classes.other: Calls that got a response without an HTTP status, such as gRPC or MCP.
history.calls.reasonLegend: Accessible name of the group of checkboxes that filter the calls that got no response by why they failed.
history.calls.reasons.timeout: Why a send got no response: it took longer than the time limit.
history.calls.reasons.connection: Why a send got no response: the connection to the server or the proxy could not be made, for example refused.
history.calls.reasons.dns: Why a send got no response: the host name could not be found.
history.calls.reasons.tls: Why a send got no response: the TLS handshake or the server certificate failed.
history.calls.reasons.cancelled: Why a send got no response: the person stopped it.
history.calls.reasons.blocked: Why a send got no response: Gostman refused the address, for example a private address on the web app.
history.calls.reasons.other: Why a send got no response: any other failure.
history.calls.reasons.unknown: Filter label for no-response calls saved by an earlier version, which did not keep the reason.
history.calls.noResponseBecause: Status of a call with no response. {{reason}} is a short reason such as Timed out.
history.calls.exportCsv: Button that saves the calls shown as a CSV file.
history.calls.csv: Column headers of the exported CSV file.
history.calls.minPlaceholder: Placeholder of a short number field; ms is milliseconds.
history.calls.maxPlaceholder: Placeholder of a short number field; ms is milliseconds.
history.calls.resetZoom: Button that zooms the chart back out to every call.
history.calls.barLabel: Tooltip of a bar in the chart. Keep the order of the placeholders if your language allows.
